name: diagram-design
description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. 52 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
one_liner: An AI skill that draws clean, on-brand diagrams (flowcharts, architecture maps, etc.) as a single self-contained HTML file — no more ugly default auto-generated chart boxes.
buyer: A startup founder or technical writer who needs investor-deck-quality diagrams but can't afford a designer and hates how AI-generated diagrams usually look.
business_use_cases: A fractional CTO uses it to produce clean architecture diagrams for client pitch decks and technical docs in minutes.
A content agency offers 'AI-generated, on-brand diagrams' as an add-on service for blog posts and case studies.
A no-code founder builds documentation sites with professional-looking diagrams without hiring a designer.

money_ideas.idea: Sell branded diagram 'theme packs' (color palettes, fonts, styles) as one-off purchases.
Offer a hosted 'describe your system, get a diagram' web app as a subscription for non-technical founders.

steal_this: Build a tiny web wrapper around the skill — paste your architecture notes, get a polished diagram, charge per export.
